controles.affirmation: resume : "sans litige ni perte a signaler"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 note 5 : "The company has no material accruals for pending litigation or claims for which accrual amounts are not disclosed in these interim financial statements and notes, nor are material losses deemed probable for such matters." 10-K FY2025 Item 3 : "There are various lawsuits and claims against the company involving product liability, intellectual property, employment and commercial issues." Aucun litige nomme, aucune sanction reglementaire.

controles.affirmation: Croissance interne 5% au T2 et 3% au S1 2026 (pour +10% et +8% publies) ; 2% sur 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Revenue growth | 10 % | 8 %", "Impact of acquisitions | 5 % | 4 %", "Impact of currency translation | 1 % | 2 %", "Organic revenue growth (non-GAAP measure) | 5 % | 3 %". 10-K FY2025 : croissance publiee 4%, organique 2%.

controles.affirmation: 73 438 M$ d'ecart d'acquisition + incorporels = 65% de l'actif (113 174 M$) et 1,39x les capitaux propres (52 686 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q au 27/06/2026 : "Goodwill | 54,832", "Acquisition-related intangible assets, net | 18,606", "Total assets | $ | 113,174", "Total equity | 52,686". 73438/113174=64,9% ; 73438/52686=1,394.

controles.affirmation: "Sur 9 098 M$ payes pour Clario, 5 934 M$ en ecart d'acquisition et 3 796 M$ en incorporels, soit 96% du prix en actifs sans existence physique" (repete a l'identique dans le bloc quantitatif)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, allocation Clario : "Customer relationships $ 2,510 | Product technology 844 | Trade names 19 | Backlog 423 | Goodwill 5,934 | Net other assets/(liabilities) 386 | Contract liabilities (375) | Deferred tax assets/(liabilities) (645) | $ 9,098". 5 934 + 3 796 = 9 730, soit 107% du prix paye, pas 96%.
controles.correction_proposee: "soit 107% du prix, l'exces etant compense par 645 M$ d'impots differes passifs et 375 M$ de passifs de contrats" (2 occurrences a corriger).
